statement_only.purpose: Export the exact compiled theorem type without following its proof dependency graph.

body_theorem_equation.purpose: Export proof bodies for small computation equations tied to the actual definition.
required_evidence: imported proof body is Rocq-kernel checked

definition_body_projection.purpose: Project only the audited computational body needed by a semantic bridge.

guarded_normalization.purpose: Normalize a known expensive subexpression such as Finset.sum over a half-open interval.
required_evidence: kernel-checked guard bound to this compiled expression

universe_sensitive_datatype_interface.purpose: Export constructor/equation interfaces for artifact-local List and other universe-sensitive datatypes.
